scope: The checkpoint-saving policy preserves more snapshots than the measurement schedule uses. All registered measurement obligations are complete; archival-only snapshots are not extra scientific trials or scored endpoints.
archival_only_policy: 72 U/IMU regularized snapshots at 150/1500 steps and 15 G/IMU snapshots at 0/100/300/1200/2400 are retained by the shared saving policy. No measurement was registered for these snapshots. They do not fill an unavailable primary endpoint.
